programs.name: RCP-edge-alias-w
programs.text:
VERT
DCL IN[0]
DCL IN[1]
DCL OUT[0], POSITION
DCL OUT[1], GENERIC[0]
DCL OUT[2], GENERIC[1]
DCL TEMP[0..1]
DCL CONST[0]
IMM[0] UINT32 {255, 15, 1056964608, 1065353216}
MOV TEMP[0], IN[1]
RCP TEMP[0].w, TEMP[0].xyzw
MOV OUT[1], TEMP[0]
USHR TEMP[1], TEMP[0], CONST[0].xxxx
AND TEMP[1], TEMP[1], IMM[0].xxxx
SHL TEMP[1], TEMP[1], IMM[0].yyyy
OR TEMP[1], TEMP[1], IMM[0].zzzz
MOV OUT[2], TEMP[1]
MOV OUT[0], IN[0]
END
